author: maintainer-agent

patch.value:
## Problem
The active graph reports zero isolates and zero degree-one nodes, which reads as healthy. It is not the property that matters. What matters for an agent is whether a traversal from an item reaches an outcome that explains it, and how many typed hops that takes. A workspace can be fully connected and still be a flat list wearing a graph costume.

## What good looks like
From any active item, following typed edges reaches an outcome milestone; the path passes through the epic that owns the capability, the feature that delivers it, and the decision that authorised it; and each hop is explainable from the edge kind alone. That is depth, and depth is what makes graph algorithms useful for context assembly rather than decorative.

## Measures to add
Depth distribution and eccentricity per active node; shortest typed path to any outcome milestone; edge-kind diversity along that path; count of nodes reachable only through a single parent edge; component structure of the active subgraph excluding parent edges, which is the honest test of semantic linkage.

## Boundary
No density targets and no fabricated edges. An unreachable item is a signal that either an anchor is missing or the item should not be active — both are answers, and both are better than an invented edge.
Strategic reachability invariant: every active item resolves to an outcome milestone through a typed, explainable path within a bounded hop count

The audit profile reports depth distribution, eccentricity, and shortest-path-to-milestone for every active item, not just isolate and degree counts; A declared policy states the maximum acceptable hop distance to an outcome milestone and the minimum distinct edge-kind count on the path; Violations surface as audit findings with a remediation hint naming candidate anchors, never as an instruction to fabricate an edge; Deliberately shallow items are representable as reviewed waivers with recorded rationale rather than silently failing; The profile is computed within the graph analytics token and latency budgets and stays bounded at million-item scale
Graph algorithms alone can answer why any item exists and which outcome it serves

The graph currently guarantees that no active item is isolated. That is a floor, not a structure: an item can satisfy it with one parent edge and still be unreachable from any strategic outcome, which means no traversal can explain why it is being worked on.

Turns the relationship graph from a connectivity artifact into a navigable explanation of the project, which is the precondition for graph-driven context assembly and for the reachability-based relevance signals the context engine wants.
A governance profile reports, for every active item, the shortest typed path to an outcome milestone and the edge-kind diversity along it; violations are findings with named owners.

Outcome milestones now exist as graph roots, so reachability finally has a defined target. Measuring depth before the terminal-history backfill waves run means the waves can be aimed at the actual gaps.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Reachability and depth baseline measured 2026-07-25 over all 2,027 items, for the bounded-hop invariant this item declares.

Active set (255 items), semantic edges only, breadth-first from the six outcome milestones:
- unreachable: 0
- depth histogram: 6 at depth 0 (the milestones), 85 at 1, 98 at 2, 25 at 3, 8 at 4, 10 at 5, 23 at 6
- maximum semantic depth: 6

Including hierarchy edges the maximum falls to 4, which is the expected result and worth stating explicitly: the parent tree is a shortcut, so any invariant measured over all edges will look healthier than the project actually is. The semantic-only measurement is the honest one and should be what this item gates on.

Two observations for the invariant's design:

1. A third of the active set (85 of 255) sits at semantic depth 1 — attached directly to an outcome milestone. That is a legacy of earlier enrichment passes that optimised for eliminating unreachable items, and direct attachment was the cheapest way to do it. It satisfies a reachability invariant while conveying little: an edge from a Semgrep finding straight to "provable history" explains nothing about the path between them. Recommend this item's acceptance criteria include a *minimum* explanatory path quality, not only a maximum hop count — for instance that the path from an execution item to its outcome traverses its capability epic rather than bypassing it.

2. Edge-kind distribution across the whole graph is heavily skewed toward the generic: related 2,007, parent 1,852, blocked_by 364, blocks 69, discovered_from 55, verifies 25, implements 15, child 15, incident_from 1. The typed kinds that carry real planning semantics — implements and verifies — account for 40 of 4,403 edges, under one percent. A bounded-hop invariant computed over `related` edges is close to a connectivity check; computed over typed edges it is a genuine claim about how work reaches an outcome. Recommend the invariant declare which kinds count as explanatory and measure only those.

Active-graph degree is saturated: exactly 28 active items carry a semantic degree of one or less, and all 28 are Semgrep findings whose deliberate hub topology routes through per-file and per-rule representatives. No honest edge remains to be added there, and none should be fabricated.

value.text: Baseline and first movement measured 2026-07-26, so this invariant now has a number to enforce rather than an aspiration. Before: the six outcome milestones carried almost no inbound typed edges — pm graph impact <milestone> --kind implements,verifies --direction incoming returned 1, 0, 0, 1, 5 and 2 nodes for j82fd3, 9rgaal, w7ccmv, o87av6, xp1xsw and t4d7nz respectively. The strategic layer was wired with the untyped related kind (2,089 edges) which no traversal treats as semantic, so 'every active item resolves to an outcome milestone' was unmeasurable, not merely unmet. After a three-wave typed-edge pass over open items only (implements 49 to 286, verifies 41 to 91, total edges 4,558 to 4,877, zero new cycles, zero new audit findings): reach per milestone is 61, 36, 22, 49, 123 and 16 at shortest-path distances up to 5, and 268 of 271 active items reach at least one outcome. The three that do not are the outcome milestones themselves, which are roots. Two structural notes for this item's gate design. First, the parent hierarchy alone cannot satisfy this invariant: parent chains terminate at pm-doxj, the roadmap root, which is not an outcome, so the typed layer is load-bearing rather than redundant with hierarchy. Second, the four items that needed hand-wiring were exactly those whose parent is closed (pm-5ecnar under pm-pim7, pm-5sm91o under pm-j36ypd) or whose parent is the roadmap root (pm-95d7), which identifies the two structural cases a gate must handle rather than treat as one-offs.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Depth baseline for the terminal corpus, measured 2026-07-26 during the relationship backfill, so this item has real numbers to build its metrics on rather than active-only ones.

Before the pass, over 1,795 terminal items: 1,024 had no outbound edge at all, 822 had none in either direction, 1,682 had no edge of any kind that semantic traversal accepts, and 184 had no parent. The active graph reported 0 isolates and 0 degree-at-most-one nodes at the same moment, which is the exact illusion this item exists to correct — active-scoped depth metrics certified a healthy graph while 86 percent of the workspace was unreachable.

Evidence classes and their yield, for whoever builds the coverage profile: typed hierarchy mirror 1,607 edges, explicit identifier references in durable text 2,244 edges, shared linked artifact 45 edges, shared issue reference 2 edges. The steep fall-off after the first two classes is itself a finding — artefact and issue co-reference add almost nothing once hierarchy and explicit references are exhausted, so a future completeness metric should weight those two classes heavily and treat the others as tie-breakers rather than as independent coverage dimensions.

Reachability after the pass, single-node probe: graph impact from closed item pm-00yy in the outgoing direction reaches 1,444 nodes across 9,568 inspected edges, from a node that previously had no traversable outbound edge at all. That is the depth this item wants to measure, and it is now measurable.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Baseline for this invariant, measured 2026-07-27 after the epoch-lineage tranche recorded on pm-lnrk.

Universal reachability now holds and is worth freezing before it decays: all 2,116 nodes are in one connected component, zero orphans, and every item — 1,805 terminal and 308 active — reaches the index root through typed edges only. Before the tranche it was 820 of 1,805 terminal.

This is the moment a ratchet is cheapest to install. The property is currently true, so the gate can be a hard equality rather than a burn-down: any item that cannot reach the index root through the typed kinds is a failure, with no grandfathered set to carve out. Every previous attempt to install a graph-quality gate had to start from a nonzero baseline and therefore had to encode an exemption list that then became permanent.

Two measurements this item should carry alongside the boolean, because reachability alone is a weak property. Depth distribution: max typed depth 24, with the number of items at depth seven or more roughly doubling in this tranche, which is the shape that makes ancestry queries informative rather than flat. And kind composition of the paths: the tranche added 214 edges of which zero were related, so the reachability is genuinely semantic. A future tranche that restored reachability using related edges would satisfy a naive gate while destroying the property this item exists to protect, so the gate must assert the typed-only path, not merely a path.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Depth baseline measured 2026-07-28 over every tracked item file, by walking the parent scalar to its root.

Distribution: depth 0 has 185 items, depth 1 has 421, depth 2 has 1,201, depth 3 has 325, depth 4 has 33, depth 5 has 6, depth 6 has 1. Maximum hierarchy depth is 6 and 1,807 of 2,172 items, 83 percent, sit at depth 2 or shallower. The modal shape of this corpus is milestone to epic to leaf.

Read against the ordering side, pm graph analyze reports layer_count 7 and critical_path_length 6 on 2,045 ordered nodes with a frontier of 1,799, so neither axis exceeds seven levels. The hierarchy is broad and shallow by construction: 59 of the 175 true roots are per-session Epics that were never joined to a programme, which inflates the root count and caps every chain that would otherwise pass through them.

This is the honest answer to whether graph algorithms can reconstruct the project's timeline today: they cannot go deeper than six hops on either axis, and the deepest available chain, the v1 milestone sequence, is stored in reverse. Depth is not a target to be inflated with edges — the constraint is that the two structures that would produce genuine depth, programme lineage over the session epochs and a correctly directed ordering chain, are both blocked on the direction canonicalization pm-4020c5 owns. Evidence and refusal recorded on pm-1w6scp.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Connectivity milestone reached, measured 2026-07-29 at build 2026.7.29.

The knowledge graph is now a single component containing every node: component_count 1, largest_component_size 2,199 of 2,199 nodes, orphan_count 0, orphans empty. The prior recorded figure was one component holding 2,058 of 2,097 nodes, or 98.1 percent. Active-node coverage holds at zero isolated and zero degree-at-most-one across all ten types. Total edges 9,928 over ten kinds: related 4,720, implements 2,072, parent 2,027, blocked_by 430, blocks 222, discovered_from 239, verifies 150, supersedes 56, child 8, incident_from 2.

The practical consequence for this item's metrics: eccentricity and shortest-typed-path-to-milestone are now defined for every node in the corpus, closed and canceled included, because there is no longer any node the walk cannot reach. Whatever depth measurement this item settles on can be computed over the whole corpus rather than over the active slice plus a caveat.

The counterpart number that did not move is recorded on the ordering item: 1,815 of 2,069 ordered nodes still have no predecessor and the critical path is still length 6. Full connectivity of the knowledge graph and shallowness of the ordering graph are consistent - the corpus is densely cross-referenced and weakly sequenced.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Active-graph typed-coverage census, 2026-07-30, parsing BOTH on-disk dependency encodings plus the scalar parent channel across all 2,205 item files.

Result: of 310 active items, exactly ZERO have no outbound connection, and exactly ONE has neither a non-related dependency row nor a scalar parent - pm-doxj, which is the roadmap root and correctly has no parent. Two active items carry only related-kind dependency rows: pm-gos426, filed this session and since given an implements edge to the agent-legible-grammar outcome, and pm-efkvdy, whose only honest partners are class siblings rather than derivations, so related is the correct kind for it and no edge was fabricated.

Whole-corpus kind distribution from graph audit at the same commit: related 4,750, implements 2,075, parent 2,036, blocked_by 439, discovered_from 245, blocks 222, verifies 153, supersedes 56, child 8, incident_from 2. Total 9,986 edges over 2,204 nodes, one connected component, zero orphans, and 11 graph-audit findings all severity info and all legacy.

Two measurement traps worth recording for the next census, both of which produced a false 310-of-310 zero-coverage reading before they were fixed. First, toon scalar fields are written UNQUOTED for id, type, status and parent, so a regex expecting a quoted value matches nothing and every item looks parentless. Second, a tabular-only dependency parser silently misses the expanded encoding, and an expanded-only parser misses the tabular one; a census must run both branches and union them, because splitting an expanded row on commas also turns the source_kind value into a bogus kind token.

Reading against this item's invariant: depth is not the deficit. The active layer is fully typed and fully reachable. The remaining shallowness is in the ordering relation specifically - 1,821 of 2,074 ordered nodes still have no predecessor - and that is an authoring-time capture gap already owned elsewhere, not something a census or a sweep can fix.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Graph state measured after the 2026-07-30 (evening) pass, recorded here because this item owns the reachability invariant rather than the isolate count.

Registry profile: 2,220 nodes, 10,041 edges, 320 active nodes, 0 isolated active nodes, 0 active nodes of degree one or less, coverage clean across all ten active types. Edge kinds: related 4,764, implements 2,089, parent 2,048, blocked_by 443, discovered_from 256, blocks 222, verifies 153, supersedes 56, child 8, incident_from 2. Connectivity: one component holding all 2,220 nodes, zero orphans.

The change worth recording is on the ordering axis rather than the connectivity axis. Ordered nodes 2,090, layers 10, frontier 1,834, and critical path length 9, against a critical path of 6 measured on the previous pass. The frontier ratio is unchanged at 87.7 percent, so the graph did not get less flat overall, but the longest genuine ordering chain grew by three because this pass wrote readiness edges that compose with existing ones rather than sitting beside them: the budget-enforcement issue is now blocked by the feasibility issue, which is blocked by the envelope-amortisation issue, and each of those edges carries its reasoning in the mutation message. Eight legacy ordering cycles remain, unchanged, and are the same known set.

Reachability held for every item this pass created or reorganised. All eleven, five new issues plus the five external intake items re-parented from the roadmap milestone to their capability epics plus one, reach all six outcome milestones through typed paths at distances between one and three, and each reaches between 1,814 and 1,815 nodes outward. No edge was fabricated to achieve that: every implements edge names a milestone whose acceptance the item actually serves, every blocked_by edge names a sequencing reason recorded in its history message, and the two related edges join class siblings where similarity is the honest relation.

Method note that keeps holding: depth cannot be manufactured. The critical path grew because three real sequencing facts were discovered during the pass, not because a chain was imposed on a set of siblings. A pass that finds no sequencing facts should leave the number where it is.
